description: This file defines the NextWordPrefsProvider class, which implements the PrefsProvider interface to manage preferences related to next-word suggestions in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles retrieving and storing preferences for different locales, utilizing auxiliary classes like NextWordsStorage and NextWordsContainer.

classes.name: NextWordPrefsProvider
classes.description: A class that provides preference management for next-word suggestions, supporting retrieval and storage of preferences per locale.

methods.name: NextWordPrefsProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with application context and locales to store.

methods.name: providerId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this preferences provider.

methods.name: getPrefsRoot
methods.description: Builds and returns the root of preferences, including stored next-word suggestions for each locale.

methods.name: storePrefsRoot
methods.description: Stores the preferences for each locale based on the provided PrefsRoot object.
